review.method: Visual review of the silent benchmark source

steps.title: Open the source editor
steps.instruction: Open the source editor for the Wikipedia article.

steps.title: Add link markup
steps.instruction: Put double square brackets around the article term.

steps.title: Preview the link
steps.instruction: Select preview and verify that the new link opens the correct article.

steps.title: Save the edit
steps.instruction: Enter an edit summary and save the page.
